Expected upstream_failure: R odbc warns instead of rejecting unknown field.types names. Reference: https://github.com/r-dbi/odbc/blob/v1.4.2/R/dbi-table.R. Reproducer: repros/r-contract.R.
Reported FAILED: `expect_error(dbWriteTable(con, table_name, test_in, field.types = c(b = "INTEGER")))` threw an unexpected warning.
Message: Some columns in `field.types` not in the input, missing columns:
  - 'b'
Class:   simpleWarning/warning/condition
